title: Camera mode
subtitle: Use this device to watch over your home

pair.lead: On the guardian's phone open Family → Add camera and enter the 6-digit code shown there.
pair.invalid: The code is wrong or has expired.
pair.limited: Too many attempts. Try again in 10 minutes.
pair.retry: Could not reach the server. Check your internet.
pair.unavailable: The server is not set up yet. You can try test mode.
pair.removed: This camera was removed from the family. Connect it again with a new code.
pair.localLead: Try AI detection on this device without connecting. No notifications are sent.

ready.localLead: Test mode: detections only appear on this screen.
ready.tip1: Place it up high where it sees the whole room
ready.tip3: Keep this page open and the screen on
ready.permission: Asks for camera and microphone access
ready.cctv: CCTV mode: watching the go2rtc stream on {host}

loading.modelsHint: About 10 MB the first time, quick after that

error.camera: The camera or microphone did not open. Check the browser's permissions.
error.models: Could not load the AI models. Check your internet.

watch.note: The AI runs on this device. Video never leaves it; only a snapshot of a dangerous moment is sent.
watch.hidden: Watching stops when the screen turns off. Keep this page open.
watch.noMic: No microphone: watching by video only
